summary.name: AppFlowy
summary.one_liner: AppFlowy is an open-source, self-hostable AI workspace for managing projects, wikis, and data across desktop, mobile, and web, positioned as an alternative to Notion.
use_cases: Self-hosting a team wiki and documentation
Replacing Notion for personal or team notes
Managing projects and tasks with databases
Running an AI workspace in an air-gapped environment
Syncing notes across Linux, Windows, macOS and mobile devices
summary.what_it_does: AppFlowy is a workspace for projects, wikis, and data, with AI features built in. It runs on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android, and the web, with sync across devices. It can be deployed on your own infrastructure, in a private cloud, or fully air-gapped. The page lists enterprise controls including built-in identity and access management, granular permissions, fine-grained control over AI access, SCIM provisioning and LDAP integration, and horizontal scaling across nodes. It also states compliance certifications: SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO/IEC 27001.
notable: Open source and self-hostable, deployable in air-gapped environments
Enterprise identity features: SCIM, LDAP, granular permissions
Scales horizontally across multiple nodes for large deployments
Listed as open-source, freeware in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac under Note-taking
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the page mentions cost savings but gives no plan prices
Page marketing claims (savings figures, download counts, reviews) are not independently verified
